hjsbx1be0lmoslp9.name: Restrain
hjsbx1be0lmoslp9.description:
When the jailer makes a successful mancatcher Strike, their target must succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:27] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} until the end of the jailer's next turn.

Each time the target fails an attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} the jailer, it takes @Damage[2d6[piercing]] damage.

9kdhw0jv0lj57xjt.name: Subduing Attack
9kdhw0jv0lj57xjt.description:
Abendego jailers deal an additional 3d6 precision damage to creatures that are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} or within reach of at least one of their allies.

The jailer can make an attack with this additional damage as a nonlethal attack, if they choose.

fb9tq8ocb98sl1mc.name: Halfling Luck
fb9tq8ocb98sl1mc.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger Thiarvo fails a skill check or a saving throw

Effect Thiarvo rerolls the triggering check and must use the new result.

tjsum3u1y9q79gai.name: Fighting Rod
tjsum3u1y9q79gai.description: Thiarvo's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.6wVWwpL9pYr3yQtt]{Rod of Wonder} is supple wood and can be used as a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.17MQKaMIHQAJNtuu]{Fighting Stick}. It can be enchanted with fundamental runes but not property runes, and it's currently enchanted with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.DKWuJb2rSgiotOG7]{Weapon Potency (+1)} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.DxCuJKynlnMQZHgp]{Striking} runes.

hwhksgxt4f6ui2os.name: Lethal Fighter
hwhksgxt4f6ui2os.description: Thiarvo can make lethal attacks using weapons with the nonlethal trait without taking the usual -2 penalty. His attacks with weapons with the nonlethal trait deal an additional 2d8 precision damage, whether he's making nonlethal attacks or lethal attacks with them. This damage is included in his melee entry.

8f596g9ds4362vda.name: Slippery Halfling
8f596g9ds4362vda.description: Thiarvo ignores difficult terrain from trees, foliage, rubble, and undergrowth.

Ssumzili.name: Ssumzili
Ssumzili.description: Ssumzilis are lanky, murderous fey who delight in the thrill of the hunt. They are particularly skilled/adept at stalking their prey in the rain and most commonly reside in rainforests and coastal regions, where frequent rain provides ample opportunity to hunt. Camouflaged by their cloud-gray skin, ssumzilis often compete in tests of stealth when hunting in groups, taking particular delight in approaching their quarry as closely as possible without being observed.

uovsta00w6nycpdc.name: Deluge Vision
uovsta00w6nycpdc.description: A ssumzili ignores sensory difficulties caused by rain.

jsf0vyocbwrayp3d.name: Precipitation Camouflage
jsf0vyocbwrayp3d.description: A ssumzili can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} in rainfall, even if it doesn't have cover.

78szm6iaxw3d58yq.name: Standing Water
78szm6iaxw3d58yq.description: 10 feet. When it rains, the ground near a ssumzili becomes slick. When raining, all terrain within 10 feet of a ssumzili is slippery, with the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Wu0xFpewMKRK3HG8]{Grease} (DC 29). Ssumzilis are immune to this effect.

vk9ugiypfhn6ztji.name: Puddle Stride
vk9ugiypfhn6ztji.description: A ssumzili ignores difficult terrain caused by rain, such as puddles or wet rocks.

oSlZ5h47sAGSUiEK.name: Sneak Attack
oSlZ5h47sAGSUiEK.description: A ssumzili deals an additional 2d6 precision damage precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

4o6reppukpfo6pb7.name: Soaking Strike
4o6reppukpfo6pb7.description:
The ssumzili makes a melee Strike. If the Strike damages the target, the target must also attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:32] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature becomes soaked, causing them to treat the environmental temperature as one step colder (mild to severe, severe to extreme, and so on) until they dry off.

Failure As success, and the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure but the fatigue lasts until the target gets a full night's rest.

e77kx9kh3ao1pfk0.name: Soul-Shaking Croak
e77kx9kh3ao1pfk0.description:
Grouloop utters a powerful croak that deals @Damage[6d10[sonic]|options:area-damage] damage to any non-boggard within a @Template[emanation|distance:30] (@Check[fortitude|dc:27|basic|options:area-effect] save).

A creature with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} condition that fails its saving throw increases its frightened condition by 1 (on a critical failure, the creature is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for as long as it is frightened).

Grouloop can't use Soul-Shaking Croak again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Soul-Shaking Croak]]{1d4 rounds}.

q19s4nupvasfksu1.name: Swamp Stride
q19s4nupvasfksu1.description: Grouloop ignores difficult terrain caused by swamp terrain features.

q2xt5rycxzs5o14q.name: Tongue Grab
q2xt5rycxzs5o14q.description:
If Grouloop hits a creature with her tongue, that creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}. Unlike with a normal grab, the creature isn't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}, but it can't move beyond the reach of Grouloop's tongue.

A creature can sever the tongue by hitting AC 24 and dealing at least 9 slashing damage. Though this doesn't deal any damage to the boggard, it prevents her from using her tongue Strike until she regrows her tongue, which takes a week.

j8nw283x3fpg7c4n.name: Breath of Silt
j8nw283x3fpg7c4n.description:
30 feet. A creature that begins its turn within the area feels as if its lungs are filling with silt and must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:25] save or be unable to speak or breathe. The creature can still hold its breath and can attempt a new saving throw at the end of its turn.

A creature that succeeds is temporarily immune to breath of silt for 24 hours.

b4jimi9slce5dn1j.name: Rise Up
b4jimi9slce5dn1j.description:
Trigger A creature walks on top of the bog mummy amalgamation lying buried in the silt below

Requirements Initiative has not yet been rolled

Effect The bog mummy amalgamation notices the creature automatically and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.H6v1VgowHaKHnVlG]{Burrows} before rolling initiative.

01a3lifskgsrbu3f.name: Bog Rot
01a3lifskgsrbu3f.description:
This affliction can't be reduced below stage 1, nor can the damage from it be healed, until it's successfully treated with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SUKaxVZW2TlM8lu0]{Cleanse Affliction} or a similar effect; the affliction can then be removed as normal for a disease.

A creature killed by bog rot melts into a noxious sludge and can't be resurrected except by a 7th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kqhPt9344UkcGVYO]{Resurrect} ritual or similar magic

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:21]

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 minute)

Stage 2 @Damage[3d6[void]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} (1 day).

o6226qjukr9btk86.name: Fist Flurry
o6226qjukr9btk86.description: The amalgamation makes two fist Strikes against two different targets within its reach. Its multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after both attacks.

xo8i3ja1q3n1u3pf.name: Flash of History
xo8i3ja1q3n1u3pf.description:
Frequency three times per day

Trigger Halbrux is about to attempt a skill check

Effect Halbrux peers into lore of the past and increases the level of success by one step (for example, a success becomes a critical success).

m7gnh3byd6frbkkv.name: Resolve
m7gnh3byd6frbkkv.description: When Halbrux rolls a success on a Will save, she gets a critical success instead.

k033kr4ite954wop.name: Curse of Torrential Knowledge
k033kr4ite954wop.description:
When halbrux uses her revelation spells, her mind fills with a flood of disorienting information.

The first time Halbrux casts one of her revelation spells in a day, she takes a -4 penalty to initiative rolls until the next time she makes her daily preparations.

The second time Halbrux casts one of her revelation spells in a day, she is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the next time she makes her daily preparations.

c5u8stvcew53sws7.name: Predictive Blows
c5u8stvcew53sws7.description:
Trigger Halbrux's turn begins

Effect Halbrux identifies the immediate movements of a creature she can see and attempts a @Check[fortune-telling-lore|defense:reflex]{Fortune-Telling Lore} check against that creature's Reflex DC.

On a success, Halbrux's melee Strikes deal an additional 4d6 precision damage (6d6 precision damage on a critical success) to the creature until the end of Halbrux's turn.

km24nwckr7mfjzhx.name: Quickened Casting
km24nwckr7mfjzhx.description:
Frequency once per day

Effect If Halbrux's next action is to cast a cantrip or a 4th-rank or lower spell, reduce the number of actions to cast it by 1 (minimum of 1 action).

8k5gl1t2crs9n9kf.name: Steady Spellcasting
8k5gl1t2crs9n9kf.description: If a reaction would disrupt Halbrux's spellcasting action, she attempts a @Check[flat|dc:15|showDC:owner] check. On a success, the action isn't disrupted.

YhTp7RIQLVLYYNUn.name: Sticky Feet
YhTp7RIQLVLYYNUn.description: Giant frogs are not off-guard when @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balancing} on a narrow surface, and they gain a +4 bonus to Reflex saves to avoid falling.

YlO5up5kkSrroKf6.name: Tongue Grab
YlO5up5kkSrroKf6.description:
A creature hit by the riding frog's tongue becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} by the riding frog. The creature isn't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}, but it can't move beyond the reach of the frog's tongue. A creature can sever the tongue with a Strike against AC 13 that deals at least 2 slashing damage.

This deals no damage to the frog but prevents it from using its tongue Strike until it regrows its tongue, which takes a week.

0.label: to High Jump or Long Jump

OLe8kSmPlknSKFzU.name: Sneak Attack
OLe8kSmPlknSKFzU.description: A boggard hunter deals an additional 2d6 precision damage precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

emgnuw2mh8qiq7ad.name: Swamp Stride
emgnuw2mh8qiq7ad.description: A boggard hunter ignores difficult terrain caused by swamp terrain features.

1t5k82i3zc64lvie.name: Terrifying Croak
1t5k82i3zc64lvie.description: The boggard unleashes a terrifying croak. Any non-boggard within @Template[emanation|distance:30]{30 feet} becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} unless they succeed at a @Check[will|dc:25] save; those who critically succeed are temporarily immune for 1 minute.

DYjmZykzGtcQQ6HO.name: Tongue Grab
DYjmZykzGtcQQ6HO.description:
If a boggard hunter hits a creature with her tongue, that creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}. Unlike with a normal grab, the creature isn't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}, but it can't move beyond the reach of the boggard hunter's tongue.

A creature can sever the tongue by hitting AC 22 and dealing at least 7 slashing damage. Though this doesn't deal any damage to the boggard, it prevents it from using their tongue Strike until they regrows their tongue, which takes a week.

8o33rm2v5gd0rvt4.name: Deny Advantage
8o33rm2v5gd0rvt4.description: Ajbal isn't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to creatures of 13th level or lower that are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}, undetected, flanking, or using surprise attack.

24hp1wpz5omum3lj.name: Evasion
24hp1wpz5omum3lj.description: When Ajbal rolls a success on a Reflex save, he gets a critical success instead.

68v7hncdjrbmqmdo.name: Nimble Dodge
68v7hncdjrbmqmdo.description:
Trigger Ajbal is targeted with a melee or ranged attack by an attacker he can see

Effect Ajbal gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.

kfve6pvuzvhob5a8.name: Hunt Prey
kfve6pvuzvhob5a8.description:
Ajbal designates a single creature he can see and hear, or one he's Tracking, as his prey. Ajbal gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} his prey and Survival checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EA5vuSgJfiHH7plD]{Track} his prey.

The first time Ajbal hits his designated prey in a round, he deals an additional 2d8 precision damage. Ajbal also ignores the penalty for making ranged attacks within the second range increment when attacking his prey.

These effects last until Ajbal uses Hunt Prey again.

RvR1Yfq0sqsvCbUh.name: Sneak Attack
RvR1Yfq0sqsvCbUh.description: Ajbal deals an additional 1d6 precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

33007yaiq5m1taxz.name: Tear the Wound
33007yaiq5m1taxz.description:
Requirements Ajbal's last action was a melee Strike that dealt sneak attack damage to an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} target

Effect Ajbal deals @Damage[6[bleed]] damage to the target creature, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for as long as it's bleeding.

utqgvsqenn9bu4th.name: Trident Bully
utqgvsqenn9bu4th.description: A trident Ajbal is using gains the shove trait, and any creature Ajbal critically hits with a trident is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the start of Ajbal's next turn.

q3iiuioxoja6dk4q.name: Orc Superstition
q3iiuioxoja6dk4q.description:
Trigger Onyiji is about to make a saving throw against a spell or magical effect

Effect Onyiji gains a +1 circumstance bonus to the triggering save.

93mg0jw3efbc6prt.name: Spellstrike
93mg0jw3efbc6prt.description:
Frequency twice per day

Effect Onyiji casts a spell and couples it with a staff Strike. She casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6DfLZBl8wKIV03Iq]{Ignition}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gYjPm7YwGtEa1oxh]{Ray of Frost}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.r3NeUnsgt9mS03Sn]{Shocking Grasp}, but the effects don't occur immediately. She makes a melee Strike with her staff and uses the attack roll result as the effect of both the Strike and the spell.

This counts as two attacks towards her multiple attack penalty, but the penalties don't apply until after the Spellstrike.

ayacm2lkwvhcnv2z.name: Twisting Tree
ayacm2lkwvhcnv2z.description:
When Onyiji wields a staff in one hand, it gains the agile trait and its damage die size increases to d6 (these adjustments are reflected in the Strike above). When she wields a staff in two hands, it gains the parry, reach, and trip traits.

She can Interact to Release or change her grip on her staff as a free action when she Strikes with the staff (including Strikes made in a Spellstrike).

v36yv0ju3wex1iqi.name: Deflecting Cloud
v36yv0ju3wex1iqi.description:
Trigger Ixamè is the target of a ranged attack

Requirements Ixamè is aware of the attack and has a free wing

Effect Ixamè rapidly flexes one of her wings and creates a billowing cloud of mist. She is treated as if she were @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} for the purposes of resolving the triggering attack, so normally the attacker must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:11] to target her.

Ixamè also gains a +4 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.

gb6rtm7tl445foxn.name: Mist Vision
gb6rtm7tl445foxn.description: Fog and mist don't impair a cloud dragon's vision; Ixamè ignores the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} condition from fog and mist.

uxs81m99g4ichpaa.name: Breath Weapon
uxs81m99g4ichpaa.description:
Ixamè breathes a cloud of poison like that emitted from Terwa Lake that deals @Damage[11d6[poison]|options:area-damage] damage in a @Template[cone|distance:40] (@Check[reflex|dc:29|basic|options:area-effect] save).

She can't use Breath Weapon again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Breath Weapon]]{1d4 rounds}.

kkq35lzs9wigaqoe.name: Cloud Walk
kkq35lzs9wigaqoe.description: Ixamè can tread on clouds or fog as though on solid ground.

v0qz15a2mjb59cek.name: Draconic Frenzy
v0qz15a2mjb59cek.description: Ixamè makes two claw Strikes and one horn Strike in any order.

1x3lh2qqctoita74.name: Draconic Momentum
1x3lh2qqctoita74.description: Ixamè recharges her Breath Weapon whenever she scores a critical hit when making a Strike.

Spider Summoning Rune.name: Spider Summoning Rune
Spider Summoning Rune.desc (hazard): An @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} rune on the floor summons a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.eP4a0FAbus3tNTbc]{Goliath Spider} when disturbed by someone who isn't wearing Norgorber's religious symbol.
Spider Summoning Rune.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:34|name:Erase the Rune|traits:uncommon,magical,trap,complex] (master) to erase the rune or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (6th rank; counteract DC 36) to dispel the rune.

qukoi30nkcrl9vcl.name: Summon Animal
qukoi30nkcrl9vcl.description:
Trigger A creature that isn't wearing a religious symbol of Norgorber enters the area above the rune

Effect The trap summons a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.eP4a0FAbus3tNTbc]{Goliath Spider}. The goliath spider rolls initiative and remains for [[/r 2d6 #rounds]]{2d6 rounds}, after which the spell ends and the spider disappears. The spider also disappears if someone disables the trap before the duration expires. Unlike most summoned creatures, the goliath spider can use 3 actions each round and can use reactions.

6qwnr9ssl3hh85x4.name: Sodden Defense
6qwnr9ssl3hh85x4.description:
Trigger An attacker misses or critically misses the Abendego priest with a melee Strike

Effect The priest calls upon the endless storm to punish the attacker. Seawater appears in the target's lungs and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 3} if the triggering attack was a critical miss).

DFseyQDb0s0jkEBU.name: Sneak Attack
DFseyQDb0s0jkEBU.description: The Abendego priest deals an additional 2d6 precision damage precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

fqckqxn62rrgouj6.name: Steady Spellcasting
fqckqxn62rrgouj6.description: If a reaction would disrupt the priest's spellcasting action, they attempt a @Check[flat|dc:15]. On a success, the action isn't disrupted.

Screaming Sulfur.name: Screaming Sulfur
Screaming Sulfur.description:
A screaming sulfur is a creature born from gasping death and suffocating suffering. When an earthquake or other geological phenomena releases toxic gases, these gases can build up beneath lakes and other large bodies of water. Eventually, they escape the water, expanding into massive clouds that cover the immediate area. Its silent, unexpected arrival can take thousands of lives in an instant. Confused, in pain, and desperate for a way out, the dying souls become trapped in the noxious cloud and amass into this horrifying creature.

While not truly undead, a screaming sulfur shares many similarities with undead creatures, including the malice of vengeful spirits and the hatred of all living creatures who breathe freely and painlessly.

A screaming sulfur resembles a cloud made of countless, featureless faces, mouths agape and releasing ghastly wails.

fPMLlH0s8d3DPSbO.name: Site Bound
fPMLlH0s8d3DPSbO.description:
A screaming sulfur becomes bound to the location where the people whose souls make up its form died. It can stray up to 1,000 feet from this site of death, or up to 100 feet from the edges of any waterway associated with its death, whichever distance is shorter.

A typical ghost can stray only a short distance from where it was killed or the place it haunts. A typical limit is 120 feet. Some ghosts are instead bound to a room, building, item, or creature that was special to it rather than a location.

avye4ki1pqr7g6ln.name: Agonizing Cries
avye4ki1pqr7g6ln.description:
30 feet. The screaming sulfur constantly shrieks with the pained wails of countless spirits.

A living creature that enters or starts its turn in the aura must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:26] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} as long as it remains in the aura (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a critical failure).

A creature that succeeds is temporarily immune for 1 hour.

DhxhfUgnu5iRDTWL.name: Rejuvenation
DhxhfUgnu5iRDTWL.description:
Blessing the site where the screaming sulfur was formed and burying whatever dead remain allows the spirits within the screaming sulfur to move on to the afterlife, rendering it inert.

When a ghost is destroyed, it re-forms after [[/br 2d4 #days]]{2d4 days} within the location it's bound to, fully healed. A ghost can be permanently destroyed only if someone determines the reason for its existence and sets right whatever prevents the spirit from resting.

zx5k069eu1mqck0j.name: Choke
zx5k069eu1mqck0j.description: The screaming sulfur bombards all creatures within its Agonizing Cries aura with visions of death and a feeling of suffocation. Each creature takes @Damage[4d6[mental]] damage (@Check[will|dc:26|basic] save).

tew93zc38tdbtkse.name: Poison Sense (precise) 30 feet
tew93zc38tdbtkse.description: A karumzek senses any poisoned creature. It can spend an action with the concentrate trait to determine the poison's type and current stage.

9mktwykhulu3lc4o.name: Change Shape
9mktwykhulu3lc4o.description: A karumzek can take the shape of a Tiny spider. This doesn't change its Speed or Strikes.

eezf25m1slduyc4d.name: Karumzek Venom
eezf25m1slduyc4d.description:
Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:19]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[1d6[poison]] (1 round)

Stage 2 1d6 poison and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[2d6[poison]], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}, and enfeebled 1 (1 round)

r2ezwnk7aqzsorz5.name: Born Lucky
r2ezwnk7aqzsorz5.description:
Frequency once per day Trigger The Terwa chosen rolls a success or a critical failure on a check

Effect The Terwa chosen improves the triggering roll by one degree of success, only from a success to a critical success or from a critical failure to a failure.

udqc7wyyetj7r9g4.name: Deep Breath
udqc7wyyetj7r9g4.description: A Terwa chosen can hold their breath for 10 minutes.

j8a2y33slhmfgn10.name: Celestial Might
j8a2y33slhmfgn10.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect The Terwa chosen calls upon the stars to empower their attack. They attempt a Strike. If the Strike hits, the Terwa chosen deals an additional 2d6 precision damage.

cakus4is2nfhmd30.name: Champion's Star
cakus4is2nfhmd30.description:
Frequency once per hour

Effect The Terwa chosen looks to the sky for a star to guide their attack. The Terwa chosen gains the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Gb7SeieEvd0pL2Eh]{Sure Strike}.

nte7kutbe3lsm1cz.name: Cat's Luck
nte7kutbe3lsm1cz.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger Yonsuu fails or critically fails a Reflex saving throw

Effect Yonsuu rerolls the saving throw and takes the better result.

7xb9wi0nsdyrp0lb.name: Hampering Strike
7xb9wi0nsdyrp0lb.description: A foe that takes damage from Yonsuu's melee Strike is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 3} if the Strike is a critical hit).

Xs4GwCjt0hjJoSXY.name: Subduing Attack
Xs4GwCjt0hjJoSXY.description:
Yonsuu deals an additional 3d6 precision damage to creatures that are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} or within reach of at least one of their allies.

Yonsuu can make an attack with this additional damage as a nonlethal attack, if they choose.

kxzi9fot877vdfzq.name: Deep Breath
kxzi9fot877vdfzq.description: A Terwa star reader can hold their breath for 10 minutes.

uyqangw1ssetun1h.name: Move the Stars
uyqangw1ssetun1h.description:
Frequency once per day Trigger An attack or effect would reduce an ally within 30 feet to 0 Hit Points or would cause the ally to gain the dying condition

Effect The star reader interprets the meaning of astrological omens in an instant, determining a new fate for the ally. The triggering ally remains at 1 Hit Point, does not increase their dying or wounded condition, and gains 10 temporary Hit Points for 1 round.

jkhwxgqejbao0fio.name: Guiding Star
jkhwxgqejbao0fio.description: The star reader finds the star that would guide their own attack or that of an ally. The star reader grants themselves or an ally within 30 feet the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Gb7SeieEvd0pL2Eh]{Sure Strike}. If the star reader chooses an ally, the duration lasts until the end of that creature's turn. The target is then temporarily immune to Guiding Star for 1 day.

r4u4hrul35e6wuo9.name: No Escape
r4u4hrul35e6wuo9.description:
Trigger A creature within Bharlen's reach moves away from her

Effect Bharlen Strides up to her Speed, following the foe and keeping it in reach throughout this movement.

z9nxRoV9X4JXQGKZ.name: Rejuvenation
z9nxRoV9X4JXQGKZ.description:
When Bharlen is destroyed, her armor rebuilds its body over the course of [[/gmr 1d10 #days]]{1d10 days}-or more quickly if the armor is worn by a living host. If the body is destroyed before then, the process restarts.

Bharlen can only be permanently destroyed by obliterating her armor (such as with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.r7ihOgKv19eJQnik]{Disintegrate}), transporting it to the Forge of Creation, or throwing it into the heart of a volcano.

krLWtxJ9ADxs0NNg.name: Sacrilegious Aura
krLWtxJ9ADxs0NNg.description: 30 feet. When a creature in the aura uses a vitality spell or ability, Bharlen automatically attempts to counteract it, with a [[/r 1d20+18 #Counteract]]{+18} counteract modifier.

5uc0oqmgvy5p7xce.name: Brute Strength
5uc0oqmgvy5p7xce.description: Bharlen deals an extra 1d8 damage with tridents, and a trident gains the shove trait while she is using it in melee (both the extra damage die and the shove trait have been included in Bharlen's trident Strikes above).

5iw3o97yu174ys02.name: Devastating Blast
5iw3o97yu174ys02.description:
Bharlen unleashes crackling lightning in a @Template[cone|distance:30|damaging:yes]. Creatures in the area take @Damage[6d12[electricity]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:30|basic|options:area-effect] save).

Bharlen can use this ability once every [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Devastating Blast]]{1d4 rounds}.

p7wf8wll2sl70wxv.name: Graveknight's Curse
p7wf8wll2sl70wxv.description:
This curse affects anyone who wears a graveknight's armor for at least 1 hour.

Saving Throw @Check[will|dc:40|traits:curse] save

Onset 1 hour

Stage 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1} and cannot remove the armor (1 day)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 2}, all speeds reduced by 10, and cannot remove the armor (1 day)

Stage 3 dies and transforms into the armor's graveknight.

ywxautmdrllyrr0f.name: Ruinous Weapons
ywxautmdrllyrr0f.description: Any weapons Bharlen wields gain the effects of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.DKWuJb2rSgiotOG7]{+1} @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.DxCuJKynlnMQZHgp]{Striking} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.NVst7e69agGG9Qwd]{Shock} runes.

cjvszxu7947dx7ts.name: Sodden Strike
cjvszxu7947dx7ts.description: Bharlen calls to the endless storm to lend murderous power to her blows. She makes a Strike; on a hit, seawater appears in the target's lungs and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 3} on a critical hit).

hywkev85wdk8blk9.name: Weapon Master
hywkev85wdk8blk9.description: Bharlen has access to the critical specialization effects of any weapon she wields.

41wnvdbo0yfh9ho4.name: Deep Breath
41wnvdbo0yfh9ho4.description: A terwa prodigy can hold their breath for 10 minutes.

LacGOd6744WQoep2.name: Poison Sense (precise) 30 feet
LacGOd6744WQoep2.description: A karumzek senses any poisoned creature. It can spend an action with the concentrate trait to determine the poison's type and current stage.

Df5EF5Xp2UJLcuBf.name: Karumzek Venom
Df5EF5Xp2UJLcuBf.description:
Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:28]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[4d6[poison]] and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[5d6[poison]], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[6d6[poison]], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}, and enfeebled 2 (1 round)

wkx0zg9p09ltwahi.name: Swarming Bites
wkx0zg9p09ltwahi.description: Each enemy in the karumzek swarm's space takes @Damage[2d6[piercing]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:27|basic] save) plus karumzek venom.

sl8elo0dgxo97mkq.name: No Escape
sl8elo0dgxo97mkq.description:
Trigger A creature within the brute's reach moves away from the brute

Effect The brute Strides up to their Speed, following the foe and keeping it in reach throughout this movement.

alml4yv5gueceol5.name: Brute Strength
alml4yv5gueceol5.description: Abendego brutes deal an extra 2d8 damage with tridents, and a trident gains the shove trait while the brute is using it in melee (both the extra damage dice and the shove trait are included in the fighter's fork Strikes above).

854bcge93kw67a9p.name: Ranged Feint
854bcge93kw67a9p.description: When the Norgorberite spy successfully @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feints} a creature, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against the spy's ranged attacks as well as melee attacks.

tp0wkvck5vm09z96.name: Reaper's Protection
tp0wkvck5vm09z96.description:
Trigger The spy is about to attempt a saving throw

Effect The spy touches their religious symbol of Norgorber and gains a +2 circumstance bonus to the triggering save.

su8sm4dwugl8vk8q.name: Quick Draw
su8sm4dwugl8vk8q.description: The Norgorberite spy Interacts to draw a weapon, then Strikes with that weapon.

aLhg6IhcRwMgKtGn.name: Sneak Attack
aLhg6IhcRwMgKtGn.description: The Norgorberite spy deals an additional 4d6 precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures or creatures within reach of at least two of their allies.

s8925ad90z8czuya.name: Surprise Attack
s8925ad90z8czuya.description: On the first round of combat, creatures that haven't acted yet are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to the Norgorberite spy.

62yzfcmu1uvfkpv5.name: Brutal Recovery
62yzfcmu1uvfkpv5.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger The cyclops bully fails (but does not critically fail) an attack roll or an Intimidation check

Effect The cyclops bully forces its will on an array of possible futures. It gets a success on the roll instead of a failure.

lidmnsqlvmmttgo4.name: Terrorizing Swing
lidmnsqlvmmttgo4.description:
The cyclops bully attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} a foe within its melee reach, then makes a melee Strike against that foe.

If the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} and takes damage, it takes an additional 2d10 damage and is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

This counts as two attacks toward the cyclops's multiple attack penalty.

Golgopo.name: Golgopo
Golgopo.description:
As their empire crumbled and fell into ruin, many cyclopes turned to increasingly depraved and vicious rituals to enhance their divinations and oracular powers. Some, especially those too fearful or suspicious of their fellow cyclopes to collaborate, constructed servants known as golgopos to aid in their rituals. These squat creatures are made from ancient bones dredged from fetid swamps and packed with mud to resemble a squat humanoid. Their heads are little more than the skull of whatever creature's bones were used in their creation with an extra eye socket punched in the forehead, glowing with eerie light.

Golgopos spend most of their time perched on the shoulder of a cyclops master, acting as secondary casters for foul rituals and casting spells to aid them as needed. Golgopos are generally not evil, however, and one whose master has abandoned them or been destroyed might be convinced to employ their knowledge of ritual magic in service of another.

0q8sc28cczzxrdd9.name: Ritual Conduit
0q8sc28cczzxrdd9.description:
Golgopos were created to assist with complex rituals. The golgopo can always use Occultism to attempt secondary checks during rituals, regardless of the skill normally required.

If a golgopo would critically fail a secondary check, they fail instead.

pzlu2abxa2vkt5u7.name: Warning Call
pzlu2abxa2vkt5u7.description:
Trigger A creature targets an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} ally within 10 feet of the golgopo

Effect The golgopo has a premonition of the attack and shouts a warning to their ally. The ally gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.

mwosf5epfidka0is.name: Portents of Doom
mwosf5epfidka0is.description:
The golgopo unleashes a wailing cry that heralds impending disaster. Each creature within @Template[emanation|distance:30]{30 feet} must attempt a @Check[will|dc:26] save.

Golgopos and cyclopes are immune to this effect.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 round.
